newsitem.title: USA: Infu-Tech in deal to merge with IVonyx.
newsitem.headline: Infu-Tech in deal to merge with IVonyx.

text.p: Infu-Tech Inc, a home and outpatient healthcare company, said Tuesday it has signed a letter of intent to merge with IVonyx Group Services Inc, a provider of home infusion therapy services through 13 direct, company-operated home infusion centers. Infu-Tech will be the surviving entity.
Terms of the merger were not disclosed.

For the fiscal year ending June 30, Infu-Tech reported revenues of $24.6 million and net income of $1.2 million. With the addition of IVonyx, based in Livonia, Mich., which the company said has annual revenues of about $30 million, the revenue base of the combined entity will more than double.
